model.name: bad-parent-loc: Add folder fails in the MODEL view on a collection (Tron, reported MULTIPLE TIMES)
model.description: TRACKED DEFECT (the ONE home Tron repeat reports attach to; carries the LITERAL error string so an intake search by what he SEES finds it). Tron, verbatim behaviour: "Add folder failed bad-parent-loc in the model view on a collection" — reported MULTIPLE TIMES. The verb is OFFERED but FAILS with error bad-parent-loc. Root: the model endpoint routes every add-folder through the physical-create path (FolderService.ts:138 returns {ok:false,error:bad-parent-loc}) for a parent with no real directory (a virtual/model Folder, e.g. diagrams collection). Doctrine: folder != directory. Fixed by R40.87 (routing branch to model-store) + enumerated on R40.37 (applicability) + R37.33 (dir base-resolution).
tronReports: prior reports (multiple, exact dates not on disk — the intake gap this defect fixes)
